records.body: The trapdoor sits behind the Stranger, next to a wagon, and a low crawl leads to the chest. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: The chest is under the Beighen Candlery, reached through a trapdoor behind the Stranger.

steps.text: Travel to Beighen in Pailune and find the Candlery.
Open the trapdoor behind the Stranger, next to a wagon.
Crouch through the low opening.
Open the chest and take the shield.

records.name: Legion Spearmen's Large Shield
records.summary: A large shield in a hidden room above Delesyia South Gate, opened with Force Palm on a disguised wall.
records.body: From the south gate, look north, climb the masonry, and Force Palm the panel that does not match the rest of the wall. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: The chest is in a hidden room at Delesyia South Gate; that gate has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Travel to Delesyia South Gate.
Face north and climb the stone wall.
Force Palm the camouflaged wall panel.
Open the chest in the hidden room and take the shield.

records.name: Witch's Ring
records.summary: A ring paid for finishing the Thinning Blade stretch of the Sage of the Desert chapter.
records.body: Paid at the close of Thinning Blade, the Chapter 9 trial that crosses the Spire of the Sun. Like other jewelry, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: The Thinning Blade reward list names Witch's Ring with Greymane's Earring.

steps.text: Play Thinning Blade and make for the Spire of the Sun.
Finish the trial on the far side.
Collect Witch's Ring.

records.name: Ring of Lightning
records.summary: A ring finished at the Kilnden Workshop after a two-minute rain charge.
records.body: The Kilnden Workshop and every named Kuku piece rest on one KeenGamer article. The craft needs two minutes of rain before it will complete. Like other jewelry, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: Crafted at the Kilnden Workshop after a two-minute rain charge; that recipe has no record here yet.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and open the Kilnden Workshop.
Speak with Grimnir at the bench.
Hold the craft in the rain for two minutes.
Finish Ring of Lightning at the workshop.
